name: The pulse
description: Every two hours, the companion reads the facts and its ledger, then acts: staffs what is ready and lets it go, files what it found, marks what needs you, asks at most one question. A note per pulse in the companion project. Off until you turn it on; a pulse missed is not caught up — the next one reads the same state.

limit.title: Runs to look at
limit.description: The most recent runs the pulse reads.
